summary: Evaxion A/S, a Danish clinical-stage TechBio company listed on Nasdaq (EVAX) and a foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K on October 2, 2026, carrying a press release announcing scientific presentations rather than any transaction. New immune-profiling data for AI-designed personalized cancer vaccine EVX-01 plus pembrolizumab in advanced melanoma will be presented orally and as a poster at SITC 2026 in Phoenix, November 4-8, 2026, with full three-year phase 2 data due at ESMO on October 24, 2026. No terms, board recommendation, advisor or structural mechanics are stated. Watch for the ESMO readout as the clinical catalyst; no deal or arbitrage angle exists.
